# Water Supply Fixture Units - WSFU vs. GPM and Liters/sec

The Water Supply Fixture Unit (**WSFU**) is defined by the American Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC) and is used to calculate the demand in water supply systems.

**Key Conversion:** 1 WSFU = 1 GPM

This conversion is suitable for single or a few fixtures. When many fixtures are combined, the number must be compensated for intermittent use through probability curves or tables for sizing water supply lines.
